title: Coarsest SIRead granularity: max_pred_locks_per_page=0, per_relation=0
configuration_cause: Predicate-lock granularity caps remain at defaults (max_pred_locks_per_page=2, max_pred_locks_per_relation=-2), so SIRead locks promote to coarser relation/page granularity under the SERIALIZABLE GetUserTweets read path, adding per-txn lock bookkeeping and tail latency on the dominant transaction class.
mechanism: GetUserTweets consumes 88% of terminal capacity at p99 1816us while lock_waiting_backends stays 0 and server_retry_ratio is 0.0, so the cost is SIRead lock bookkeeping, not lock contention or serialization aborts. Setting max_pred_locks_per_page=0 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=0 forces the coarsest page/relation SIRead granularity, minimizing per-tuple predicate-lock entries and promotion work per transaction. This is the untested opposite extreme of the granularity axis (r005 tested 2->8, r006 tested 2->32); it should cut locks_total.p95 and GetUserTweets p99, freeing terminal capacity for higher successful TPS.
query_effect: GetUserTweets read path performs fewer SIRead lock insertions and promotions per call, lowering its p99 tail without changing the plan.
expected_tps_effect: Modest increase in successful transaction TPS as terminal capacity is freed on the dominant transaction class.
expected_latency_effect: GetUserTweets p99 decreases; p50 roughly unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Coarsest SIRead granularity removes per-tuple predicate-lock entries, lowering total lock count p95.
Less per-txn predicate-lock bookkeeping trims the dominant transaction's tail.
Freed terminal capacity on GetUserTweets raises completed transaction throughput.

alternatives.statement: If lock_waiting_backends rises above 0, the coarsest granularity increases false conflicts and the mechanism is contention-driven rather than bookkeeping-driven.
If locks_total.p95 is unchanged, predicate-lock bookkeeping is not on the critical path and the terminal bottleneck lies elsewhere.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent leaves predicate-lock granularity at defaults; the untested coarsest extreme directly targets the dominant transaction's SIRead bookkeeping with no contention risk given zero lock waits and zero retries.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Safe low bound 0; forces coarsest page-level SIRead locking. Prior r005 tested 2->8 (refuted), r006 tested 2->32 (untested); 0 is the untested opposite extreme of the same granularity axis.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: page-level predicate-lock granularity cap; 0 forces coarsest page-level SIRead locking

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Safe low bound 0; forces coarsest relation-level SIRead locking. Prior r005 tested -2->4 (refuted), r006 tested -2->16 (untested); 0 is the untested opposite extreme.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: relation-level predicate-lock granularity cap; 0 forces coarsest relation-level SIRead locking
